sources.parcels_bexar: Bexar Public Works candidate universe; finalists batch re-verified through SARA/BCAD
sources.parcels_comal: Comal CAD public ArcGIS parcel layer; data edit date November 22, 2024
sources.parcels_guadalupe: Guadalupe CAD / TxGIO public parcel extract; February 2022 vintage; secondary GBRA project-feed corroboration attempted
sources.plats: Bexar Public Works plat stages; comparable countywide plat feed not yet loaded for Comal/Guadalupe
sources.permits: City of San Antonio building permits past 180 days; regional counties have lower permit-data confidence
sources.roads: TxDOT statewide roadways plus CoSA/Bexar local road sources where available
sources.flood: FEMA NFHL flood hazard polygons; fetched by node envelope and intersected parcel-by-parcel locally
sources.land_use: City of San Antonio Future Land Use where available
sources.utilities: Mapped existing sewer proximity: SAWS (Bexar), NBU (Comal/New Braunfels), GBRA (Guadalupe); capacity unverified

methodology.architecture: Node first -> county parcel universe -> hard filters -> 60% location / 40% parcel execution -> confidence -> category
methodology.freshness_policy: Only recent Bexar parcel data can earn PRIORITY. Aging Comal data is capped at WATCH. Guadalupe 2022 data is capped at EARLY unless corroborated by a newer GBRA project parcel feed, then WATCH is possible.
methodology.hard_gate: 3+ ac; <=1 mi parcel-edge distance; road signal >=66; raw-land >=60; shape >=30; node >=52/confidence >=45; FEMA <10% floodway/<50% SFHA and >=3 usable-acre proxy; excluded public/institutional/major-anchor/homebuilder ownership.
methodology.priority_rule: Bexar only; recent parcel source; score >=78; confidence >=68; <=0.60 mi to node; major-road access proxy; flood >=75; parcel execution >=68; mapped sewer within 1,000 ft proxy.
